nom: Mixsoon Collagen Glass Skin Hydrating Mask

avis.titre: so far so good! but apply a lot
avis.texte: i have only used this mask once, but so far i do love it! it left my skin hydrated, smooth, suuuuper glowy, and even a little excess residue/serum for me to pat into my skin after i peel the mask off… IF i were able to peel this off. my only downside is how thick you need to apply this mask. i applied it too thin, resulting in me having to tediously rub/peel tiny segments of the mask from my face little by little…. resulting in a little loss of glow. i ultimately believe the lack of peeling from the mask itself was a user error on my end, but its unfortunate that you need to use more product to get a nicer/easier peel. even though i had to rub some of the serum off in order to get the mask off itself, i still have beautiful glowy skin after this product. i just hope the glow lasts all day! *tiny side note: i recommend those of you with sensitive skin to do a patch test on the inside of your wrist or elbow before using!! i do have sensitive skin and once i first applied this product i did notice the faintest of tingling, but it went away after a few minutes, and my skin did not look irritated after taking the mask off.
